system.description:
Magic that gets through your guard doesn't get through clean. Once per encounter, when you fail a saving throw against a harmful spell or effect, halve the damage taken from it.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
